references.text: The prophet Isaiah speaks of rejoicing in the Lord and being clothed with garments of salvation and a robe of righteousness, which can be seen as a precursor to the idea of wedding garments in Matthew.
The psalm describes a royal wedding scene where the bride is dressed in exquisite clothing, which may reflect the theme of being properly attired for a wedding.
Revelation speaks of the fine linen of the saints, which represents the righteous acts of the righteous, something that can be connected to the idea of wedding garments in Matthew.
Revelation mentions those who will walk with Jesus in white clothes because they are worthy, which can be related to wearing proper wedding attire.
Revelation describes a great multitude clothed in white robes, washed clean in the blood of the Lamb, which can be seen as a parallel to being properly dressed for God's kingdom.
